name: browserstack-ai-tfa
description: BrowserStack's test-failure-analysis plugins for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

plugins.name: tfa-rca
plugins.description: Point it at a red BrowserStack build: it reads every failed test, clusters them by failure signature, gathers evidence from the tools you already have, and lands a root cause per test naming the pull request most likely responsible. Requires a GitHub route; everything else degrades to a recorded gap.
